name: Stow
subtitle: A calmer YouTube, with no Shorts.

apps.name: Stow
apps.subtitle: A calmer YouTube, with no Shorts.
apps.localizedDescription: Plays and downloads the videos your Mac picks, plus YouTube's Home and Subscriptions and search, with no Shorts. Pairs with the Stow Mac app.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Pull up at the end of Home or Subscriptions to check for new videos, the same as pulling down at the top.
- Animations reworked to feel like the YouTube app: the player follows your finger and settles at its speed, and sheets, messages, player controls, thumbnails and lists move quickly and smoothly.

- Stow can now work without the Mac: on first launch choose "Use on its own" (or switch in Settings). The phone follows channels and checks for new videos itself, with no Firebase.
- Optional YouTube sign-in on the phone for Home, Subscriptions, members-only videos, importing your subscriptions and watched sync.
- In standalone mode, new videos show up when you open Stow or when iOS gives it background time.

- Stow shows when a new version is out: Settings › About, or the banner on Home, then Update in SideStore.
- Upload dates on search results and channel pages, said the way YouTube says them ("3 days ago", "1 year ago").
First iPhone version. Not yet tested on a real iPhone: install it with SideStore or AltStore from ios/source.json, then pair it from Phone › Pair a Phone on the Mac.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Stow uses the camera to scan the pairing code on your Mac.
